An entry here is a recorded debt, NOT an approval to keep the code. The gate
(orphan_modules --check) fails on any orphan NOT listed here, and on any
listed module that is no longer an orphan (delete its entry when you delete
IMPORTANT: 'nothing imports it' has TWO causes, and they need opposite fixes.
- superseded: a dead duplicate of live code. Fix = delete (review phase3/010).
- unwired: an intended feature/tool/infra that was built but never hooked up.
Fix = wire it in (or consciously remove it) -- an OWNER decision, not a
mechanical cleanup. Deleting these would destroy real functionality and
hide the wiring bug, which is the same class of error this review exists
Classification below is from the 2026-08-10 investigation; unwired entries are
AWAITING an owner wire-vs-delete decision and must NOT be deleted until then.
